programme.title: Undergraduate Requirements | CS
programme.degree: Bachelor of Science in Computer Science (Henry Samueli School of Engineering and Applied Science)
programme.how_found: cs.ucla.edu/undergraduate-program/ (redirects to /undergraduate-requirements/); admission.ucla.edu for the six questions
programme.notes: Admission to the major is through the UC application to UCLA Samueli (OASA).

english.notes: No published minimum on ucla.edu: the international page says 'We look for competitive English proficiency scores, including a TOEFL iBT score of 5 or higher (with sub-scores of 5 or higher) on the revised scale (effective January 21, 2026), or above 100 (with sub-scores above 24) on the previous 120-point scale, as well as 7.5 or above on the IELTS or 135 or higher on the Duolingo English Test (DET).' These are competitive levels, not stated minimums (UC system minimums are on universityofcalifornia.edu, not a ucla.edu page). Source: https://admission.ucla.edu/apply/international-applicants

gpa.notes: Prose/indicative only: 'Grades and GPA (4.0 average unweighted GPA for Fall 2025 admits)' (https://admission.ucla.edu/apply/first-year); no minimum for international applicants on ucla.edu.

deadline.quote: Applications can be submitted October 1-December 1. August 1 UC application opens October 1 - November 30 Application filing period
deadline.notes: UC application filing period for fall entry; same for all first-year applicants, international included. The page itself is inconsistent (prose 'October 1-December 1' vs table 'October 1 - November 30') and prints no year; both kept, the table value preferred.

value.academic_year: not stated (table 'Cost Per Academic Year (Nine Months)', page 'Updated July 2026')

tuition.notes: Nonresidents pay University Fees $16,430 plus Nonresident Supplemental Tuition $39,270 per academic year (two separate published lines; not added here). 'Figures ... represent currently approved or proposed amounts and may not be final.'

scholarship_exists.quote: UCLA offers financial support that may be awarded based on need, academic merit, your background, specific talents or professional interests.
scholarship_exists.notes: Generic UCLA scholarship statement; no named award quoted.

scholarship_international.quote: UCLA does not award scholarships or financial aid to undergraduate students who are not citizens or permanent residents of the United States.
scholarship_international.notes: Explicit exclusion of international undergraduates from UCLA scholarships and aid.
